views.text: In September 2021, Equity Mates said Dusk provided home fragrance products like candles, diffusers and essential oils, sold through physical stores and online, and noted it had operated since 2014 and listed on the ASX in November 2020 at $2 per share.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2022, Equity Mates said Dusk sat among retailers holding margins without heavy discounting, maintaining net cash, optimising inventory, and navigating currency and supply chain issues ahead of peak Christmas trading.

views.text: In September 2021, Equity Mates highlighted Dusk as profitable with margins of plus 40 per cent and a strong growth rate since FY17 of about plus 60 per cent, with pretty much no debt on the balance sheet.
